transcript:
Live from NPR News in Washington, I'm Dave Mattingly. Five men are under arrest in Britain
on suspicion of plotting an attack on a British Air Force base used by U.S. forces in the
war with Iran, NPR's Christian Wright reports.
British police arrested the five men after reports of three suspicious vehicles heading
toward the base. The men are suspected of plotting to carry out a terrorist attack involving
explosives at RAF Fairford in western England, about 100 miles from London. The U.S. Air
Force uses the Royal Air Force base for defensive operations against Iran and deploys large
bombers to launch limited strikes in the war. President Trump told reporters the suspects
were looking to do big damage and had been watched for a long time. American troops have
used the base for decades under an agreement dating back to the 1950s. Christian Wright,
NPR News.
At least one death is reported from a nor'easter that caused flooding along coastal areas of
the East Coast from the Mid-Atlantic to New England. Officials in New York City say an
employee of the city's housing authority was killed over the weekend by a falling tree.
The storm dumped heavy rains over a wide area and disrupted airline flights along the East
Coast to include New York and Boston.
A growing number of universities are rolling out courses to help people cope with concerns
about artificial intelligence and to adapt to the technology. As NPR's Windsor Johnston
reports, a new course on AI gets underway this week at Harvard University.
Some people are rushing to try every new AI tool. Others say they want nothing to do with
it. Experts say both reactions can be driven by anxiety. Harvard Medical School psychologist
Luanna Marquez helped develop a new course to address those fears.
I think there's a level of fear of the unknown that makes sense, but we need to be able to
train people to address it. And so that is why we created the course, because we have
a pressure cooker that's getting louder and louder.
Ohio State is also adding AI skills across its undergraduate curriculum. Miami University
in Ohio offers a self-paced AI fundamentals course for students, faculty and staff.
Windsor Johnston, NPR News.
The prices of gasoline and diesel fuel in the U.S. remain high. AAA says regular gas
is averaging nearly $4.48 a gallon nationwide. That's the highest on record this late in
the year. In California, regular costs more than $6. In Michigan, drivers were taken back
by one gas station off Interstate 75, charging more than $6 a gallon for regular. One of
those drivers was Morgan Esters.
I'm only going to get $10 to $20 just to get home because that's outrageous.
AAA says diesel continues to hover near record highs. It's averaging $6.45 a gallon. This
is NPR News from Washington.
Later today, the Trump administration is expected to release new fuel economy standards for
cars and light trucks fueled by gasoline. Writing on Truth Social over the weekend, President
Trump said the new standards for automakers would be less stringent and save drivers across
the U.S. thousands of dollars on the purchase of a new vehicle. Highway safety regulators
expect the administration to require new vehicles to average roughly 34.5 miles per gallon in
the 2031 model year. That's sharply lower than the rules set by the Biden administration
calling for that mileage standard to be more than 50 miles per gallon by the same model
year.
Two giant pandas from China have arrived at the Atlanta Zoo. The animals were promised
by China's President Xi Jinping during last week's state visit to the U.S. Alex Helmic
with member station WABE has more from Atlanta.
Ping Ping and Fuxuang are on loan to Zoo Atlanta for 10 years. The deal was one of the few
firmed outcomes from the three-day visit with Xi saying it was a sign of friendship between
the two countries. China has long used pandas as part of its diplomacy. The last pandas
at the zoo were sent back to China in 2024 when a previous deal expired. The bears will
be quarantined for about a month in the zoo's new giant panda complex. An opening date for
that has not yet been announced.
For NPR News, I'm Alex Helmic in Atlanta.
Wall Street closed higher as it ended the trading week on Friday. The Dow added 478
points.
I'm Dave Mattingly, NPR News, in Washington.

topics.text: Five men arrested in Britain suspected of plotting terrorist attack on RAF Fairford base
Nor'easter causes flooding along East Coast from Mid-Atlantic to New England, at least one death
Universities including Harvard roll out courses to help people cope with artificial intelligence anxiety
Gasoline and diesel fuel prices remain high across U.S., with California and Michigan seeing extreme costs
Trump administration expected to release less stringent fuel economy standards for cars and light trucks
Two giant pandas from China arrive at Atlanta Zoo on ten-year loan agreement
